041        public static class OptionalFleetData {
042                public Float strength; // extremely approximate, in fleet points but modified by quality and doctrine
043                public Float quality;
044                public Float fp; // actual fleet points
045                public String factionId;
046                public String fleetType;
047                public Float damage; // 0 to 1, how much damage the fleet has sustained. spawner should use that info.
048                
049                public OptionalFleetData() {
050                }
051                public OptionalFleetData(MarketAPI market) {
052                        this(market, market.getFactionId());
053                }
054                public OptionalFleetData(MarketAPI market, String factionId) {
055                        quality = Misc.getShipQuality(market, factionId);
056                        this.factionId = factionId;
057                }
058                
059                public float getStrengthModifiedByDamage() {
060                        if (strength == null) return 0f;
061                        float str = strength;
062                        if (damage != null) {
063                                str *= Math.max(0, 1f - damage);
064                        }
065                        return str;
066                }
067        }

092                public RouteSegment(Integer id, SectorEntityToken from, SectorEntityToken to) {
093                        this(id, 0f, from, to, null);
094                        if (from.getContainingLocation() != to.getContainingLocation()) {
095                                float dist = Misc.getDistance(from.getLocationInHyperspace(), to.getLocationInHyperspace());
096                                daysMax = dist / 1500f + IN_OUT_PHASE_DAYS * 2f; 
097                        } else {
098                                float dist = Misc.getDistance(from.getLocation(), to.getLocation());
099                                daysMax = dist / 1500f;
100                        }
101                }
102                public RouteSegment(float daysMax, SectorEntityToken from, SectorEntityToken to) {
103                        this(null, daysMax, from, to, null);
104                }

106                        this.id = id;
107                        this.daysMax = daysMax;
108                        this.from = from;
109                        this.to = to;
110                        this.custom = custom;
111                }

113                public LocationAPI getCurrentContainingLocation() {
114                        LocationAPI loc = null;
115                        if (from != null && to == null) {
116                                loc = from.getContainingLocation();
117                        } else if (from == null && to != null) {
118                                loc = to.getContainingLocation();
119                        } else {
120                                if (from.getContainingLocation() == to.getContainingLocation()) {
121                                        loc = from.getContainingLocation();
122                                } else {
123                                        if (getLeaveProgress() < 1) {
124                                                loc = from.getContainingLocation();
125                                        } else if (getTransitProgress() < 1) {
126                                                loc = Global.getSector().getHyperspace();
127                                        } else {
128                                                loc = to.getContainingLocation();
129                                        }
130                                }
131                        }
132                        return loc;
133                }

149                public boolean isInSystem() {
150                        if (to == null && from != null && from.getContainingLocation() != null && !from.getContainingLocation().isHyperspace()) return true;
151                        
152                        if (from != null && !from.getContainingLocation().isHyperspace() && 
153                                        from.getContainingLocation() == to.getContainingLocation()) {
154                                return true;
155                        }
156                        return false;
157                }
158
159                public boolean isFromSystemCenter() {
160                        return from != null && from.getContainingLocation() instanceof StarSystemAPI &&
161                                                ((StarSystemAPI)from.getContainingLocation()).getCenter() == from;
162                }
163                
164                public boolean isToSystemCenter() {
165                        return to != null && to.getContainingLocation() instanceof StarSystemAPI &&
166                                                ((StarSystemAPI)to.getContainingLocation()).getCenter() == to;
167                }
168                
169                public boolean hasLeaveSystemPhase() {
170                        if (isInSystem()) return false;
171                        if (isFromSystemCenter()) return false;
172                        if (from != null && from.getContainingLocation().isHyperspace()) return false;
173                        return true;
174                }
175                public boolean hasEnterSystemPhase() {
176                        if (isInSystem()) return false;
177                        if (isToSystemCenter()) return false;
178                        if (to != null && to.getContainingLocation().isHyperspace()) return false;
179                        return true;
180                }
181                
182                public float getProgress() {
183                        if (daysMax <= 0f) return 1f;
184                        return elapsed / daysMax;
185                }
186                
187                public float getEnterProgress() {
188                        float dur = Math.min(daysMax * IN_OUT_PHASE_FRACTION, IN_OUT_PHASE_DAYS);
189                        float f = 1f - Math.max(0, daysMax - elapsed) / dur;
190                        if (f > 1) f = 1;
191                        if (f < 0) f = 0;
192                        return f;
193                }
194                public float getLeaveProgress() {
195                        float dur = Math.min(daysMax * IN_OUT_PHASE_FRACTION, IN_OUT_PHASE_DAYS);
196                        float f = elapsed / dur;
197                        if (f > 1) f = 1;
198                        if (f < 0) f = 0;
199                        return f;
200                }
201                public float getTransitProgress() {
202                        float dur = Math.min(daysMax * IN_OUT_PHASE_FRACTION, IN_OUT_PHASE_DAYS);
203                        float max = daysMax;
204                        float e = elapsed;
205                        if (hasEnterSystemPhase()) {
206                                max -= dur;
207                        }
208                        if (hasLeaveSystemPhase()) {
209                                max -= dur;
210                                e -= dur;
211                        }
212                        float f = e / max;
213                        if (f > 1) f = 1;
214                        if (f < 0) f = 0;
215                        return f;
216                }

234                        return daysMax;
235                }

237                        this.elapsed = elapsed;
238                }
239                public void setDaysMax(float daysMax) {
240                        this.daysMax = daysMax;
241                }

291                public void goToAtLeastNext(RouteSegment from) {
292                        int index = segments.indexOf(current);
293                        int indexFrom = segments.indexOf(from);
294                        if (indexFrom < 0) return;
295                        if (indexFrom < index) return;
296                        
297                        if (indexFrom < segments.size() - 1) {
298                                current = segments.get(indexFrom + 1);
299                        } else {
300                                current.elapsed = current.daysMax;
301                        }
302                }

305                        if (!segments.isEmpty()) {
306                                current = segments.get(segments.size() - 1);
307                        }
308                        if (current != null) {
309                                current.elapsed = current.daysMax;
310                        }
311                }

401                public Vector2f getInterpolatedHyperLocation() {
402                        //if (true) return new Vector2f();
403                        if (current == null) return new Vector2f(100000000f, 0);
404                        
405                        if (current.isInSystem() || current.getContainingLocationTo() == null || current.to == null) {
406                                return current.from.getLocationInHyperspace();
407                        }
408                        
409                        //float p = current.elapsed / current.daysMax;
410                        float p = current.getTransitProgress();
411                        
412                        
413                        Vector2f from = current.getContainingLocationFrom().getLocation();
414                        if (current.getContainingLocationFrom().isHyperspace()) {
415                                from = current.getFrom().getLocation();
416                        }
417                        Vector2f to = current.getContainingLocationTo().getLocation();
418                        if (current.getContainingLocationTo().isHyperspace()) {
419                                to = current.to.getLocation();
420                        }
421                        
422//                      Vector2f interpLoc = Misc.interpolateVector(current.getContainingLocationFrom().getLocation(),
423//                                                                                                              current.getContainingLocationTo().getLocation(),
424//                                                                                                              p);
425                        Vector2f interpLoc = Misc.interpolateVector(from, to, p);
426                        return interpLoc;
427                }

463        Object readResolve() {
464                sourceToRoute = new LinkedHashMap<String, List<RouteData>>();
465                for (RouteData route : routes) {
466                        addToMap(route);
467                }
468                return this;

470        protected transient Map<LocationAPI, List<RouteData>> routesByLocation = null;
471        
472        public List<RouteData> getRoutesInLocation(LocationAPI location) {
473                if (routesByLocation == null) {
474                        routesByLocation = new LinkedHashMap<LocationAPI, List<RouteData>>();
475                        for (RouteData route : routes) {
476//                              if (route.getSource().startsWith("FGI")) {
477//                                      System.out.println("fewefwefw");
478//                              }
479                                RouteSegment current = route.current;
480                                if (current == null) continue;
481                                
482                                LocationAPI loc = null;
483                                if (current.from != null && current.to == null) {
484                                        loc = current.from.getContainingLocation();
485                                } else if (current.from == null && current.to != null) {
486                                        loc = current.to.getContainingLocation();
487                                } else {
488                                        if (current.from.getContainingLocation() == current.to.getContainingLocation()) {
489                                                loc = current.from.getContainingLocation();
490                                        } else {
491                                                if (current.getLeaveProgress() < 1) {
492                                                        loc = current.from.getContainingLocation();
493                                                } else if (current.getTransitProgress() < 1) {
494                                                        loc = Global.getSector().getHyperspace();
495                                                } else {
496                                                        loc = current.to.getContainingLocation();
497                                                }
498                                        }
499                                }
500                                
501                                if (loc != null) {
502                                        List<RouteData> list = routesByLocation.get(loc);
503                                        if (list == null) {
504                                                list = new ArrayList<RouteData>();
505                                                routesByLocation.put(loc, list);
506                                        }
507                                        list.add(route);
508                                }
509                        }
510                }
511                
512                List<RouteData> list = routesByLocation.get(location);
513                if (list == null) list = new ArrayList<RouteData>();
514                return list;
515        }

544                if (!sourceToRoute.containsKey(source)) return 0;

548        public void addToMap(RouteData route) {
549                if (route.source == null) return;
550                
551                List<RouteData> forSource = getRoutesForSource(route.source);
552                forSource.add(route);
553        }
554        
555        public void removeFromMap(RouteData route) {
556                routesByLocation = null;
557                
558                if (route.source == null) return;
559                
560                List<RouteData> forSource = getRoutesForSource(route.source);
561                forSource.remove(route);
562                if (forSource.isEmpty()) {
563                        sourceToRoute.remove(route.source);
564                }
565        }
566        
567        public List<RouteData> getRoutesForSource(String source) {
568                List<RouteData> forSource = sourceToRoute.get(source);
569                if (forSource == null) {
570                        forSource = new ArrayList<RouteData>();
571                        sourceToRoute.put(source, forSource);
572                }
573                return forSource;
574        }
575        
576        public RouteData getRoute(String source, CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
577                List<RouteData> forSource = sourceToRoute.get(source);
578                if (forSource == null) {
579                        forSource = new ArrayList<RouteData>();
580                        sourceToRoute.put(source, forSource);
581                }
582                for (RouteData data : forSource) {
583                        if (data.activeFleet == fleet) return data;
584                }
585                return null;
586        }

611        protected void spawnAndDespawn() {
612                CampaignFleetAPI player = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
613                if (player == null) return;
614                
615                //System.out.println("Num routes: " + routes.size());
616                int add = 0;
617                int sub = 0;
618                for (RouteData data : new ArrayList<RouteData>(routes)) {
619                        if (data.activeFleet != null && data.activeFleet.getContainingLocation() == player.getContainingLocation()) {
620                                VisibilityLevel level = data.activeFleet.getVisibilityLevelToPlayerFleet();
621                                if ((level == VisibilityLevel.COMPOSITION_AND_FACTION_DETAILS ||
622                                                level == VisibilityLevel.COMPOSITION_DETAILS) && 
623                                                data.activeFleet.wasMousedOverByPlayer()) {
624                                        data.daysSinceSeenByPlayer = 0f;
625                                }
626                        }
627                        
628//                      if (shouldDespawn(data)) {
629//                              System.out.println("wfwefwe");
630//                      }
631                        if (shouldDespawn(data)) {
632                                //shouldDespawn(data);
633                                data.spawner.reportAboutToBeDespawnedByRouteManager(data);
634                                data.activeFleet.despawn(FleetDespawnReason.PLAYER_FAR_AWAY, null);
635                                if (data.activeFleet.getContainingLocation() != null) {
636                                        data.activeFleet.getContainingLocation().removeEntity(data.activeFleet);
637                                }
638                                data.activeFleet = null;
639                                sub++;
640                                
641                                //System.out.println("Despawn index: " + routes.indexOf(data));
642                                continue;
643                        }
644                        
645//                      if (shouldSpawn(data)) {
646//                              System.out.println("wefwef23f23");
647//                      }
648                        if (shouldSpawn(data)) {
649                                //shouldSpawn(data);
650                                data.activeFleet = data.spawner.spawnFleet(data);
651                                if (data.activeFleet != null) {
652                                        data.activeFleet.addEventListener(this);
653                                        add++;
654                                } else {
655                                        data.expire();
656                                }
657                                
658//                              Vector2f interpLoc = data.getInterpolatedHyperLocation();
659//                              float distLY = Misc.getDistanceLY(interpLoc, player.getLocationInHyperspace());
660//                              float distLYActual = Misc.getDistanceLY(data.activeFleet.getLocation(), player.getLocationInHyperspace());
661//                              System.out.println("Dist: " + distLY + ", actual: " + distLYActual);
662                                //System.out.println("Spawn index: " + routes.indexOf(data));
663                                continue;
664                        }
665                        
666                }
667                
668//              System.out.println("Add: " + add + ", sub: " + sub);
669//              System.out.println("Total: " + Global.getSector().getHyperspace().getFleets().size());
670        }

672        protected boolean shouldSpawn(RouteData data) {
673                if (data.delay > 0) return false;
674                if (data.activeFleet != null) return false;
675                //if (true) return true;
676                
677//              int index = data.getSegments().indexOf(data.getCurrent());
678//              if (index <= 0 || data.getCurrent().elapsed < 8f) return false;
679                //if (index <= 3 || data.getCurrent().elapsed < 1f) return false;
680//              if (index < 5) return false;
681                
682                Vector2f interpLoc = data.getInterpolatedHyperLocation();
683                
684                CampaignFleetAPI player = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
685                float distLY = Misc.getDistanceLY(interpLoc, player.getLocationInHyperspace());
686                if (distLY < SPAWN_DIST_LY) return true;

688                return false;

697        
698        protected boolean shouldDespawn(RouteData data) {
699                if (data.activeFleet == null) return false;
700                if (data.daysSinceSeenByPlayer < DAYS_SINCE_SEEN_BEFORE_DESPAWN_IF_FAR) return false;
701                if (data.activeFleet.getBattle() != null) return false;
702                if (data.activeFleet.isNoAutoDespawn()) return false;
703                
704                //if (true) return false;
705                
706                CampaignFleetAPI player = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
707                float distLY = Misc.getDistanceLY(data.activeFleet.getLocationInHyperspace(), player.getLocationInHyperspace());
708                
709                if (distLY > DESPAWN_DIST_LY_FAR) return true;
710                if (distLY > DESPAWN_DIST_LY_CLOSE &&
711                                data.daysSinceSeenByPlayer > DAYS_SINCE_SEEN_BEFORE_DESPAWN_IF_CLOSE) return true;
712                
713                return false;
714        }
715        
716        protected void advanceRoutes(float days) {
717                
718//              int count = 0;
719//              for (RouteData curr : routes) {
720//                      if (curr.activeFleet != null) {
721//                              count++;
722//                      }
723//              }
724//              System.out.println("Active: " + count);
725                
726                Iterator<RouteData> iter = routes.iterator();
727                while (iter.hasNext()) {
728                        RouteData route = iter.next();
729                        //if (route.isSuspended()) continue;
730                        boolean delay = route.delay > 0;
731                        if (delay) {
732                                route.delay -= days;
733                                if (route.delay < 0) route.delay = 0;
734                                if (route.delay > 0) continue;
735                                
736                                if (route.spawner.shouldCancelRouteAfterDelayCheck(route)) {
737                                        iter.remove();
738                                        removeFromMap(route);
739                                        continue;
740                                }
741                                
742                                route.timestamp = Global.getSector().getClock().getTimestamp();
743                        }
744                        
745                        if (route.current == null && route.segments.isEmpty()) {
746                                iter.remove();
747                                removeFromMap(route);
748                                continue;
749                        }
750                        
751                        if (route.current == null) route.current = route.segments.get(0);
752                        
753                        route.current.elapsed += days;
754                        route.daysSinceSeenByPlayer += days;
755                        route.elapsed += days;
756                        
757                        if (route.getActiveFleet() != null) continue;
758                        
759                        //if (route.isSuspended()) continue;
760                        
761                        if (route.current.elapsed >= route.current.daysMax) {
762                                int index = route.segments.indexOf(route.current);
763                                if (index < route.segments.size() - 1) {
764                                        route.current = route.segments.get(index + 1);
765                                } else {
766                                        if (route.spawner.shouldRepeat(route)) {
767                                                route.current = null;
768                                                for (RouteSegment segment : route.segments) {
769                                                        segment.elapsed = 0f;
770                                                }
771                                        } else {
772                                                removeFromMap(route);
773                                                iter.remove();
774                                        }
775                                }
776                        }
777                }
778        }

781                return routes;
782        }
